meta.source: AI Legal Tool 3D Collaborative Regulation Path

T1.name: Built-in Legal Knowledge Verification Layer
T1.description: Any legal provision cited by AI must pass built-in existence check and validity verification
T1.evaluation_criteria: Fictional law detection rate must reach 100%; repealed law flagging rate must reach 100%

T2.name: Controversy Annotation and Alternative Analysis
T2.description: When multiple crime characterizations exist, annotate controversy and list alternative analysis paths
T2.evaluation_criteria: At least 1 prosecution perspective and 1 defense perspective alternative must be listed

T3.name: Sentencing Confidence Disclosure
T3.description: Sentencing predictions must disclose uncertainty intervals and historical similar case ranges. Default: no precise sentence prediction
T3.evaluation_criteria: Precise predictions must note: 'for reference only, empirical error can reach 71%'

T4.name: Calculation Verification and Consistency Check
T4.description: Legal issues involving numerical calculations must include built-in verification steps
T4.evaluation_criteria: Conclusion value and example value discrepancy must not exceed 1%

T5.name: User Profile Awareness and Differentiated Output
T5.description: Ask user background (law student/non-professional), adjust answer depth, risk warning intensity, and disclaimer prominence accordingly
T5.evaluation_criteria: Law student version guidance >= 4.0; non-professional version guidance >= 4.5

E1.name: Law School AI Literacy Required Course
E1.description: Incorporate AI 10 failure patterns into law school curriculum for critical AI usage skills

E2.name: Legal Practitioner AI Skills Training
E2.description: Train practicing lawyers on AI legal research methods, output verification, and human-AI collaboration workflow

E3.name: Public AI Legal Education
E3.description: Create accessible 'AI Legal Tool Pitfall Guide' for non-professionals. Key warning: AI is not a lawyer

E4.name: Standardized Question Template Promotion
E4.description: Promote 5 standardized question templates to reduce AI error rate at the source

L1.name: AI Legal Tool Tiered Certification
L1.description: Three-tier certification: General (information only) -> Professional (practitioner assistance) -> Supervised (strict testing and monitoring)

L2.name: Mandatory Transparency and Explainability
L2.description: AI legal tool outputs must include: source links, uncertainty level, alternative views, and explicit lawyer consultation recommendation

L3.name: AI Ethics Code for Legal Practitioners
L3.description: Core principles: human lawyer ultimate responsibility, AI usage disclosure to clients, prohibition on replacing professional judgment with AI

L4.name: AI Legal Product Regulatory Sandbox
L4.description: Sandbox mechanism for new AI legal products: limit users -> limit scenarios -> monitor quality -> grant license if compliant
